summary: LUMIASIGN ERP — pre-deploy comprehensive frontend cross-test (40+ scenarios). All 6 demo logins verified, RBAC enforced per role, all 19 admin nav links navigate without runtime errors, AI Estimator (Gemini) returns full breakdown with profit_pct ≈ 29.97% in ~30s, Invoices new-modal exposes all 6 doc_types (Tax Invoice / Estimate / Proforma / Delivery Challan / Sale Return / Credit Note), Daybook shows 3 cash tiles (Cash/Bank/UPI) with in/out + prev/next nav, Reports surfaces GST CGST/SGST/IGST breakdown and 5+ CSV export labels, Audit Log lists 177 mutating-action rows, Notifications bell opens and shows low-stock + project alerts, logout returns to /login. 38/40 scenarios PASS, 0 critical failures.

ui_bugs.issue: Console warnings on every render: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0'. Charts still render correctly after mount, but the parent has 0 width on first paint. Add minHeight/minWidth on the chart container or pass explicit dimensions to suppress.
ui_bugs.selector: ResponsiveContainer wrappers in Dashboard.jsx and CEODashboard.jsx

ui_bugs.issue: React hydration error in dev console: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Caused by emergent's instrumentation injecting <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option> rendered from {projects.map}. Functionally harmless but pollutes console; consider wrapping option label in plain text or disabling the instrumentation marker on this element.

action_items: OPTIONAL (low priority): Fix Recharts width(-1) console spam by adding explicit minHeight/minWidth to ResponsiveContainer parents in Dashboard.jsx and CEODashboard.jsx.

OPTIONAL (low priority): The <span> inside <option> hydration warning on Invoices Select originates from emergent's dev-mode instrumentation (data-ve-dynamic spans). Will not appear in production build but worth noting.
NONE BLOCKING for deploy — all RBAC, navigation, AI integration, and module-level rendering verified.
critical_code_review_comments: AppLayout.jsx NAV array is the single source of truth for role visibility — admin override happens via 'admin' being explicitly listed in each item.roles. This is consistent and easy to audit; good design.

App.js Protected wrapper has 'user.role !== "admin"' bypass for all role-gated routes — admin sees everything as intended. Audit Log uses roles=[] which only admin can access (because empty list never includes user.role, then admin bypass kicks in). Clever but non-obvious — add a comment.
Dashboard.jsx / CEODashboard.jsx Recharts containers should have explicit min dimensions to avoid first-paint width(-1) warnings.
Invoices.jsx <Select> options should not have arbitrary JSX children — currently emergent's instrumentation injects spans causing hydration warnings in dev builds.
Repeating from prior iteration: server.py is now >2400 lines. Split into routers/services modules before adding more endpoints.

context_for_next_testing_agent: App is deploy-ready. Backend was 72/72 in iteration_4. This iteration covered the full frontend cross-test: 6 logins, 19 admin nav items, 2 RBAC role checks (sales/production), AI Estimator end-to-end (Gemini call ~30s returning structured estimate with profit_pct), Invoices doc_type selector (all 6 options), Daybook 3-tile cashbook + prev/next, Reports GST + CSV exports, Audit Log (177 rows), Notifications panel, logout flow. Only minor console warnings remain (Recharts -1 width on first paint, and a dev-only <span>/<option> hydration warning from instrumentation). Main agent can self-verify those two cosmetic items.
rca of the issue: No functional bugs. Two cosmetic console warnings: (1) Recharts ResponsiveContainer reports width(-1)/height(-1) on first render — happens because parent flex container measures 0 before layout; setting minHeight on chart wrapper fixes it. (2) Hydration warning for <span> inside <option> on Invoices — caused by emergent's dev instrumentation tagging each option child with a data-ve-dynamic span; production build will not emit this warning.
